thread:
emily: Hey team, escalating a rerank issue from AcmeCorp. They started getting a huge spike of 429s on the /v1/rerank endpoint around 2025-11-12T14:12Z. Error samples attached below from their logs:

emily: "HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 14:12:30 GMT
Request-Id: req_9a3f2b4c
Retry-After: 60
X-Quota-Limit: 60000
X-Quota-Remaining: 0"

emily: They say traffic pattern didn't change on their side — same UI, same client version. They do do a lot of tiny rerank calls (10-20 items per call, lots of users polling). I'm pasting the curl they sent for reproducer: 

emily: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"query":"best docs","documents":["doc1","doc2",...],"top_k":5}'
```

emily: They included 3 request ids that got 429s: req_9a3f2b4c, req_9a3f2c7d, req_9a3f2f01. Customer is asking for root cause and a timeline. They are sensitive because this is their search UX.

mira: Thanks Emily. Quick Qs: what org id / account id? Do we have their API key prefix? Can we see their usage spikes on the console for that hour? Also, any chance they changed to retry-without-backoff in their client?

emily: Org: org-acme-112, API key prefix: sk-live-REDACTED (they sent truncated). I pulled basic usage from Console — their QPS on rerank jumped from ~120/s to ~850/s for ~5 minutes at 14:12Z. No obvious client version change.

sam: Looping in eng-platform. Two hypotheses: (A) per-route throttling kicking in for /v1/rerank (we have a separate per-route quota that's cheaper/harder), (B) quota accounting bug where rerank counting doubled cost or decremented remaining incorrectly. Also possible the burst policy for free-tier/dedicated tiers acts differently for rerank traffic.

eng-platform: Received. We'll check quota-service logs and rate-limiter buckets for org-acme-112 for 14:00-14:20Z. Can you provide the exact request-ids again and a sample of the full request body (they redacted some docs)? The request-ids will help us map to ratelimiter events.

emily: Re-sent full request body privately (S3 link) and included the three request ids in the ticket. Also adding the console screenshot showing X-Quota-Limit=60000/day and sudden drop to 0 during spike.

support-bot: Ticket #SUP-5721 created for AcmeCorp. SLA: 48hrs. Escalation level: P2. Assigned to: eng-platform.

alex: Short-term mitigations to propose to customer: 1) add exponential backoff with jitter on 429s (Retry-After header present), 2) aggregate/rerank fewer items per call (they can increase top_k to reduce frequency), 3) request temporary quota bump while we investigate. Also confirm whether they can move heavy background prefetching to off-peak windows.

mira: Good call. Also to note: rerank currently consumes 2x quota units per request compared to normal text-generation calls (by design). If they refactor into batched rerank (one request with multiple queries) they could reduce units.

sam: eng-platform update: We found repeated token-accounting timeouts in quota-service for org-acme-112 at 2025-11-12T14:11:52Z. It looks like their burst of concurrent requests tripped an internal circuit and the in-memory bucket was drained incorrectly (we saw multiple decrement events in <100ms). We're still investigating whether this is a bug or expected with current bucket implementation.

emily: Customer reaction — they want a root cause and whether this will happen again. They've already started implementing backoff but asked if we can give an ETA for a permanent fix or at least a guaranteed temporary quota increase.

eng-platform: Action plan: 1) Patch candidate to fix double-decrement logic (we think we see race condition where two workers decrement same bucket). 2) Roll a hotfix to quota-service staging and monitor for 24h. 3) If validated, roll to prod with coordination. ETA for hotfix to staging: 6 hours. ETA for prod: 24-36 hours after validation.

sam: Also checking if our per-route limiter config for /v1/rerank is overly strict for accounts with high concurrent small calls. If so, we can adjust burst size for dedicated accounts or add a config override.

mira: For the customer's immediate ask, we can approve a temporary quota bump to 120k/day for 48 hours. Emily, can you confirm the billing owner and get explicit customer approval to increase quota (and the customer knows it may increase invoice)?

emily: I pinged the customer and they approved the temporary bump. They just asked we keep them notified during the rollout.

support-bot: Quota bump request created: QB-1182 (org-acme-112) -> 60000 -> 120000 for 48h. Pending eng-platform confirmation.

eng-platform: Confirmed. We'll apply a manual quota change in the control plane once the emergency window is recorded. Also we'll correlate the request-ids with ratelimiter logs and attach any stack traces.

alex: Repro steps for eng to validate locally (from customer):
1) run k6 or wrk to simulate 800 qps with concurrency 200 against /v1/rerank using the sample body above
2) watch quota-service logs for double-decrement events and 429 responses
3) verify rate-limit headers: should include Retry-After and X-Quota-Remaining

alex: Example k6 snippet they gave: ```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  const res = http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', JSON.stringify(payload), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer sk-test' } });
  if (res.status === 429) console.log('got 429', res.headers['Retry-After']);
  sleep(0.01);
}
```

sam: I'll run a controlled load in staging with org-acme-112 config and check for the race. If we hit the race we can push the fix earlier.

emily: Customer notified and happy about the temporary bump. I'll keep them updated on hotfix progress.

mira: Notes for postmortem: - root cause candidate: quota-service race on bucket decrement under high concurrency - contributing: rerank heavy small calls pattern (UI prefetch) - immediate mitigation: backoff + temporary quota bump - medium fix: per-route burst config + patch - long-term: make quota-service operations idempotent and add stronger metrics/alerts.

eng-platform: Assigned owners: sam -> reproduce + patch, alex -> mitigation docs + customer comms template, mira -> PM/incident lead for postmortem. We'll update SUP-5721 as we make progress.

emily: Thanks all. I'll update the customer and close loop once prod patch is scheduled.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-5721 updated: eng-platform assigned. Next update due in 4 hours.
